reviews.comment: The class is very interesting but get ready to read and take lots of notes. I recommend getting a study buddy from the start to swap notes. Attendance isn't mandatory but she gives 10 pop quizzes throughout the semester. Read. The. Textbook. Highlight and take notes. An 85 is an A. Very interesting material and she knows what she is talking about.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: T/F Pop quizzes over court readings that ask very specific and hard questions. $250 textbook mandatory for first day of class. If you miss a quiz, you have to take a cumulative one at end of year, even with excused absence. Very dry and condescending when asking the class questions. Save yourself the stress and get a different prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not a bad class, interesting material. There aren't any tests which is nice, but lots of papers instead. You have to read the textbook before class because it's discussion based and participation matters a lot. Assigned readings are Supreme Court cases, tricky to understand at first. She's kinda dry sometimes but I enjoyed the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers
